rows.Origin: Bred by Larry G. Popwell, Sr. (United States, 2006).
rows.Habit:
Arching.

Height: up to 4' (up to 120cm). Width: up to 5' (up to 150cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for hedge. Vigorous. can be grown as a shrub. can be trained as a climber. prefers full sun. Disease susceptibility: disease resistant, blackspot resistant, mildew resistant, rust resistant. Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood.. Can be pruned to maintain a shorter habit.
